channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Nov 02
item.description:
85 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • PT boat front turret now uses the regular crosshair, has a wider aim cone (0.2 → 1) and reduced damage (damageScale 1 → 0.75) for both front and rear 50 cal guns.

Vehicles & Boats

  • PT boat front turret now uses the regular crosshair, has a wider aim cone (0.2 → 1) and reduced damage (damageScale 1 → 0.75) for both front and rear 50 cal guns.
  • Boat group spawns at large oil rigs reduced from two groups to one, decreasing encounter frequency.

Weapons

  • UZI 9 mm durability doubled and other balance tweaks applied, extending weapon condition life.

Birds & Critters

  • Gull groups now avoid obstacles better, have a limited startle radius, improved shooting accuracy, and can spawn in deep‑sea areas, reducing stutter and making them more predictable.
  • Birds glide when descending, their flee distance increased to 1000 units allowing map‑wide travel and explosion tracking; crows now circle corpses from higher altitude.

Systems

  • Phone system stability improved by fixing a crash that occurred during server shutdown.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Nov 01
item.description:
3 development commits

World Generation

  • Ice Lake placement rebalanced: larger ice lakes now spawn more often and anchors are used more sparsely, resulting in more varied lake distribution across new maps.

Animals & AI

  • Fixed livestock getting stuck in loops or pausing when being led, especially in tight corridors or when many animals are present.
